Welcome to Cyrus Says!
On this episode of Cyrus Says, Cyrus Broacha is joined by Hetal Dave, India’s first female sumo wrestler, and actor Shriyam Bhagnani, who plays her in the new biopic, 'Sumo Didi.'
Hetal takes us through her extraordinary journey from judo to discovering sumo wrestling, teaching herself the sport through research, training without a proper coach or system in India, reaching out to international federations, travelling abroad to compete, and fighting for recognition in a sport that almost nobody around her understood.
